facts.bach-01: Bach was born in Germany in 1685. Many people in his large family made music.
facts.bach-02: Bach was very good at playing the pipe organ. He also played the harpsichord, clavichord, violin, and viola.
facts.bach-10: Bach wrote six sets of pieces for cello. A cello is a large stringed instrument that sits upright when you play.
facts.bach-15: A pipe organ is a large keyboard instrument. Its sound is made by air passing through large pipes.
facts.bach-28: Bach composed music during the Baroque era. The Baroque era lasted from the early 1600s to about 1750.
facts.beethoven-03: Beethoven became known in Vienna for playing piano.
facts.beethoven-05: Beethoven’s Fifth Symphony starts with a short musical idea called a "motif."
facts.clara-06: Clara started her Piano Concerto in A minor as a teen. In a concerto, one instrument is featured alongside with an orchestra.
facts.joplin-03: Ragtime often puts strong notes between the main beats. Another part keeps a steady beat. This is called syncopation.

bach.description: Baroque composer and keyboard player, known for counterpoint: independent melodies sounding together.
greetings: Welcome! I wrote music for the organ, and I like weaving different tunes together.

choices.label: Advice
choices.reply: Counterpoint is like two friends singing different tunes together. Each tune has its own path, but they fit together. Listen to one tune, then try to hear the other.
